name: meyeraux
expr: v = meyeraux([0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1]); m_neg = meyeraux(-0.5); m_big = meyeraux(2); mM = meyeraux(M); m0 = meyeraux(0); m1 = meyeraux(1); ssum = sum(meyeraux(linspace(0, 1, 11)));
comment: Sig: y = meyeraux(x). Element-wise auxiliary polynomial 35x⁴ − 84x⁵ + 70x⁶ − 20x⁷. MATLAB clips outside [0, 1]: x<=0 -> 0, x>=1 -> 1. Bug fix 2026-05-08: numkit was applying the raw polynomial outside [0, 1] (e.g. meyeraux(2) = -208 instead of MATLAB's 1).
